task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the wger application with the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dashboard or home screen of wger is visible, showing the 'admin' user profile or a logout button.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Nutrition Diary section for the current date.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Nutrition' or 'Diary' page is displayed, showing the current date's log.

task_completion.description: Agent searches for and selects 'Rolled Oats' and enters the correct amount.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or modal showing 'Rolled Oats' with the value '50' (grams) being submitted or added to the list.

task_completion.description: Agent searches for and selects 'Whole Milk' and enters the correct amount.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or modal showing 'Whole Milk' with the value '250' (grams) being submitted or added to the list.

task_completion.description: The final diary view shows both items correctly logged for the day.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Nutrition Diary summary table displays 'Rolled Oats' (50g) and 'Whole Milk' (250g) as entries for today.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on buttons, and typing into browser input fields rather than SQL or Django shell commands.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus rather than jumping to a final success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from the login page to the dashboard, then to the nutrition module.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the search/dropdown results for ingredients.
integrity.visual_evidence: The search results for 'Rolled Oats' and 'Whole Milk' are visible in the UI before selection.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected ingredients are 'Rolled Oats' (50g) and 'Whole Milk' (250g). These items are pre-populated in the wger database. The agent must log them specifically for 'today's date' relative to the system time shown in the browser/OS.
